label: D2 after a2 reached S2 (common), previous trial unrewarded, late in episode / low value
explanation: Fires only at D2 and only when the agent chose a2 and landed in S2 via the common transition (100% of activations), and almost only when the previous trial was unrewarded (99.9%). It is also confined to the end of the episode: nothing before trial ~40, with the rate rising steeply through trials 80-99, which shows up as the model value being low (all activations at value < 7.5). The base conjunction D2 & a2 & S2 & prev_reward==0 has recall 1.0 but precision 0.19; adding value < 7 (a proxy for late episode) gives dev P 0.68 / R 0.90 / F1 0.78 / mass recall 0.96. Using ep_trial >= 80 instead gives F1 0.76. All variables are observed at D2 (value is the model own output), so no future variables. Magnitude is larger later in the episode and at lower value; the top windows are dominated by common-unrewarded cores. Never fires at D1/GO, after a1, in S1, after rare transitions, or after a rewarded previous trial.
